customAudit.title: LERTA Tax Abatement Policy Analysis
customAudit.subtitle: Warehouse Development Tax Breaks & Veto Override

executiveSummary.overview: Analysis of Local Economic Revitalization Tax Assistance (LERTA) policy decisions in Northampton County, focusing on controversial warehouse development tax breaks and the County Council's override of the Executive's veto.
keyFindings: County Council voted 6-3 to override Executive McClure's veto on Upper Mt. Bethel LERTA extension
River Pointe Commerce Park includes buildings over 500,000 square feet in LERTA district
Easton Commerce Park LERTA would cost Wilson Area School District $2.98 million in tax revenue
Executive sought to exclude warehouses from tax breaks but was overridden
executiveSummary.fiscalImpact: Millions in foregone tax revenue to schools and municipalities

findings.title: Veto Override on Warehouse Tax Breaks
findings.description: Northampton County Council voted 6-3 to override County Executive Lamont McClure's veto of LERTA tax breaks for Upper Mt. Bethel Township industrial development. The Executive had vetoed to negotiate limits restricting tax breaks to manufacturing only, excluding warehouses.
findings.recommendation: Controller should review long-term fiscal impact of LERTA extensions on tax base

findings.title: Wilson Area School District Revenue Loss
findings.description: Wilson Area School District would forfeit $2.98 million in tax revenue over 10 years due to LERTA approval for Easton Commerce Park (former Pfizer site) 1-million-square-foot warehouse development.
findings.recommendation: Develop comprehensive LERTA impact analysis for school districts before approval

findings.title: LERTA Expiration Confusion
findings.description: County commissioner stated industrial development LERTA had expired, requiring clarification on status of existing tax break programs.
findings.recommendation: Maintain clear registry of all active LERTA districts and expiration dates

policyContext.whatIsLERTA: Local Economic Revitalization Tax Assistance (LERTA) grants exemptions on improvements to 'deteriorated' properties. Property owners receive graduated tax exemptions over a set period.
policyContext.intendedPurpose: Revitalize blighted or deteriorated areas through tax incentives for development
policyContext.controversy: Critics argue LERTA has been used for warehouse developments that provide few jobs relative to their size and impact on communities, while supporters claim developments bring manufacturing opportunities

controllerFlags.description: LERTA veto override resulted in foregone tax revenue - recommend comprehensive impact analysis
controllerFlags.legalBasis: Home Rule Charter - fiscal oversight responsibilities

recommendations: Establish mandatory fiscal impact analysis for all LERTA applications before Council vote
Create LERTA registry with expiration dates, affected entities, and cumulative revenue impact
Consider ordinance requiring separate votes for manufacturing vs. warehouse LERTA
Develop school district notification requirements for LERTA within their boundaries
